  • Candidates must have passed 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English.

  • Candidates applying for M.Sc must have a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or Biological Sciences. For M.V.Sc, a degree in Veterinary Science is required.
